status: locked before any comparative simulation on this cohort
prehistory: 10% R, 10% C at random without replacement; uncontrolled 2 time units; one unconditioned attempt, retain extinctions
portfolio: rumor-degree top-4 anchor; seven one-swap alternatives replace its last target by next ranked outside node, degree/id deterministic ties
randomization: method order randomized per context; fresh method tapes in disjoint phase coordinates; sequential single-process timing
accounting: all auxiliary endpoint copies charged; max_calls common; CPU/wall include Python validation, betting, allocation, trace collection and all simulation calls; exclude compilation, file compression, graph construction and prehistory
stopping: all 32 graphs and 96 histories; no result-dependent graph, parameter, endpoint, tolerance or budget changes
multiplicity: Four planned cost contrasts, family-stratified graph-unit bootstrap 20,000 draws; central 98.75% Bonferroni intervals; certification-rate differences also reported with same marginal intervals, no separate success claim based on them
quality_gate: Every query in both cells must be certified at common epsilon/alpha before matched-certified-quality superiority; adjusted wall-cost ratio lower bound >1 also required. Preserve original earlier failure. No conditioning on successful queries.
descriptive: independent evaluation sample means retained; no false-certificate rate claim
power: Fixed 32 independent graphs, 8 per family: approximate 80% detectable standardized mean log-cost effect (2.498+0.842)/sqrt(32)=0.590 at two-sided alpha .0125. Not powered to prove equivalence or distinguish rare erroneous certificates.
attribution_scope: Same statistical algorithms across engines. Screened cells split alpha in half, unscreened cells use full alpha; contrasts estimate the complete screening policy including its error reservation, not information alone. RTC endpoint differences are signed, never clipped. Same size-eight one-swap portfolio as previous cohort; no claim to arbitrary overlaps.
preprocessing: No new extinction presolve in any cell; retain unchanged common simulator behavior.
